lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn2N2O8 (MnNO4) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mn centers in octahedral environments with six O neighbors (Mn–O distances 2.03–2.10 Å), while each O has two Mn neighbors and each N has five O neighbors. Corner-sharing between Mn octahedra is observed, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites.
